scope: Tinker post-trains shared Qwen3.5-4B LoRA decisions for walking, four tasks and arm recovery. H0 home-regularized clock IK, P4 0.60 N/16 s laptop control and W6 globe-leg commands are engineered and frozen before every baseline. Native gait and physical success/force/contact predicates remain fixed. Offline historical parent-prefix states supply measured counterfactual training examples; final tests are uninterrupted physical rollouts. Prior resource use remains charged to the same 224-attempt/18-hour pool.

scene.book_collision_scope: Fixed, nonsliding book terrain; visual meshes and collision envelopes share the same placements. No root motion is authored.

native_smoothness.scope: Only adjacent samples inside native walking and turning, excluding holds and book-controller phases.

display_note: Actual uninterrupted 25-Hz MuJoCo trajectories, display precision six decimals. Steps are measured from 100-Hz sole poses and contacts. Every checkpoint uses the same engineered H0/P4/W6 library and playback speed. Native gait weights remain fixed. Training changes controller-selection weights.
